answer: Agents register through a TPM/SGX enclave producing a zero-knowledge attestation of a unique kernel image and certified hardware key; the forge contract commits each identity in a Merkle state tree, while a mirror verifier rechecks quotes and nonce freshness. A Sybil attacker must provision distinct certified silicon and forge valid enclave measurements, incurring quadratic bonding cost O(N^2) and irreversible collateral slashing for duplicates.
